title: ContentView
description: A content view defining a curated set of repositories and content available to hosts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the content view.

label.description: Unique label for the content view (auto-generated from name).

organization_id.description: Organization this content view belongs to.

composite.description: Whether this is a composite content view combining other content view versions.

rolling.description: Whether this is a rolling content view.

auto_publish.description: Whether composite content views auto-publish when a component is updated.

solve_dependencies.description: Whether RPM dependencies are resolved during publish.

import_only.description: Whether this content view is only for upstream imports.

generated_for.description: If generated, indicates the purpose (e.g., import or export).

default.description: Whether this is the default content view (every organization has one).

repository_ids.description: Identifiers of repositories in this content view.

repositories.description: Repositories included in this content view.

component_ids.description: Content view version IDs for composite content views.

versions.description: Published versions of this content view.

environments.description: Lifecycle environments this content view is in.

activation_keys.description: Activation keys using this content view.

next_version.description: Next version number to be published.

latest_version_id.description: Identifier of the latest published version.
